title: A Rocket Left a Glowing 'Space Jellyfish' Over Florida. Here Is How to Catch the Next One
excerpt: A SpaceX Falcon 9 launch this week painted a glowing 'space jellyfish' across the Florida sky, and NASA's photographers were ready. The phenomenon is predictable, which means you can plan for it: the same pad launches again Monday, October 19 at 6:30 AM.

title: An Award Only for Photographers Under Three Years In. These Winners Are Worth Studying
excerpt: You do not need a decade behind the camera to make award-winning work. The AOP's Emerging Talent Awards, open only to photographers with less than three years of practice, just crowned a gold winner who rigged a 57-metre highline across a melting Icelandic glacier.

title: 1,500 Games In, the Cubs' Photographer Still Plans Every Frame Before It Happens
excerpt: Matt Dirksen has shot more than 1,500 baseball games. The Cubs' team photographer explains how he reads light, predicts endings before each pitch, and delivers publish-ready frames to social media before the next at-bat. The whole method transfers to any sideline.
